video_title: Jeremy Sochan On His Relationship With Mike Schmitz, Being Drafted No. 1 By The Texas Legends & More

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his decision to join the Texas Legends
quotes.excerpt: I think it's more than just the number one. I think the idea, the environment that they want me in, I think is the most positive thing about this.
quotes.quote: It's played out really well. I'm super comfortable here and in the right environment for me. After I got waived in Portland, I weighed all my options and we ultimately decided to contact Texas Legends and thankfully they picked me number one. But I think it's more than just the number one. I think the idea, the environment that they want me in, I think is the most positive thing about this. I'm super motivated, hungry to show myself out, and Coach Nate and everyone else who's been a part of it have given me a lot of confidence in that.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his departure from the Portland Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: I was competing for a spot, so it wasn't 100%, it wasn't guaranteed.
quotes.quote: I'm not sure. That's not really something I can control and I don't know. At the end of the day, I was competing for a spot, so it wasn't 100%, it wasn't guaranteed. I guess they wanted to go a different way. I think I did positive things in the preseason, but I guess they wanted to go somewhere else, so it is what it is.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his long-standing relationship with Mike Schmitz
quotes.excerpt: I've known Mike Schmitz for a really long time. He's seen me playing a game in Bosnia.
quotes.quote: I have a good amount. I've known Mike Schmitz for a really long time. He's seen me playing a game in Bosnia when I was 14 and I actually had an interview with him then. It was one of my first ones so it was a terrible interview, I think I stuttered and stuff, but I've known him for a long time and when this situation all happened, that was one of the first guys I talked to and it's someone that I trust and respect a lot.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his early basketball development in Poland
quotes.excerpt: That was one of the first tournaments where I decided to go to Poland and play for the Polish national team.
quotes.quote: It was Poland under 16s. I played up. That was one of the first tournaments where I decided to go to Poland and play for the Polish national team. So yeah, that's the first time that people saw me on a bigger exposure level because England isn't the best basketball-wise, so yeah.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on choosing to play for the Polish national team
quotes.excerpt: I grew up in England, so a lot of my friends are in England, but my family's from Poland.
quotes.quote: It was a tough decision. I grew up in England, so a lot of my friends are in England, but my family's from Poland and I think it's just the culture around basketball. Basketball in England isn't really present and it's getting better, but at the time it wasn't great and there was even certain things that just didn't make sense. Even for me to be a part of the national team like paying, it was expensive. So with the Polish national team, basketball is a lot bigger there, so just the opportunities, the exposure level was a lot better.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his experience playing against the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I think it's crazy because it was with the Knicks who have one of the biggest fan bases.
quotes.quote: I think it's crazy because it was with the Knicks who have one of the biggest fan bases in the world in sports and they haven't won in a long time. But then I wasn't expecting to be coming down to San Antonio to play game one. So it was weird feelings. With San Antonio, it was the process, rebuilding everything and towards the end, that's when I left. It was really cool to see how some of the same players that I started this with ended up in the finals with me. Of course I wasn't on the team, I was on the opposition, but it was still very cool to see some of those players.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his growth during his time with the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I think it was a lot of growth, a lot of ups and downs.
quotes.quote: I think it was a lot of growth, a lot of ups and downs. I see it in a positive light, but I think a lot of things happened that I couldn't really control and I think it swayed things that happened in my career.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the trade deadline rumors
quotes.excerpt: I'm always big on communication and talking to the people around me.
quotes.quote: For me, I'm always big on communication and talking to the people around me. So I got on a call with my agent and we looked at it, okay, nothing's happened. So the best thing is to have a group meeting with everyone and talk how this can work and how we can make this into a good space for both of us to work things out for the rest of the season. It didn't go that way, so it was a little surprising, but at the same time, the way things were going, I could see that happening.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his current state of mind
quotes.excerpt: I feel good, I feel healthy, I feel like I'm building on momentum.
quotes.quote: I feel good, I feel healthy, I feel like I'm building on momentum, so I'm keeping that going. Again, I think it's exciting to rediscover myself a little bit, show people who Jeremy is. I think some of the situations I've been in, I couldn't do all of it and I'm just excited to show that I'm here and when I'm on the court, I'm present.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his development as an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: I'm still 23 and I think there's a lot of things that I personally don't think I've achieved yet.
quotes.quote: Being a part of that team, just the growth we had in that team. I wasn't there the whole season, but I think from the growth we had from when I got there to the last game, I think was a true testament of the characters on that team. I wouldn't say life has changed. I'm still 23 and I think there's a lot of things that I personally don't think I've achieved yet and I think that just being able to experience that and watch a lot of it in person and seeing so many great players on my team gives me more motivation and hunger to have the same kind of roles they have.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his European basketball options
quotes.excerpt: I had a few European clubs, a couple in Spain, and then the other option was the NBL.
quotes.quote: It was all real quick. I had a few European clubs, a couple in Spain, and then the other option was the NBL. But I think ultimately, I'm still 23. There's people coming out of the draft that are my age now and I've had a past in the NBA and I feel like I've built a decent resume. So I think again, I'm going to stand on it. I belong and I don't think it's time for me to go across the seas and go back to Europe yet. I feel like I've got unfinished business here and I'm ready to do whatever it takes to get there.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on what a conversation with Greg Popovich would be like
quotes.excerpt: I think it would be a natural conversation between two humans.
quotes.quote: I think it would be positive. I think it would be a natural conversation between two humans. I don't think it would be all about basketball. I think a lot of it would be mental and I think he would always remind you who you are and what you do the best and to stick those things and stay consistent.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on how he became an Arsenal fan
quotes.excerpt: When I moved to England with my mom, she met my stepfather and he was an Arsenal fan.
quotes.quote: When I moved to England with my mom, she met my stepfather and he was an Arsenal fan. So again, growing up with him, that's my guy and I kind of followed his footsteps and I grew up watching like Santi Cazorla and all these different talented midfielders, Alexis Sanchez and just fell in love with Arsenal for life.
